text:
hannah: quick thought  compact project cards with cost chips + tiny sparkline, and an inline Expand to reveal ledger rows. better for scanning on mobile.

cristian: sounds promising. export question: how map chips -> CSV/PDF rows? invoices must remain canonical.

eli: make expand inline (not modal) and lazy-load token details on expand. virtualization for large ledgers, keyboard focus states needed.

nora: analytics: track expand-rate, invoice-download-rate, time-to-find-cost. A/B test default collapsed vs expanded for accounts with many projects.

hannah: accessibility: chips need better contrast and a clear focus ring. include aria-controls, aria-expanded, and aria-live announce on expand.

ux-bot: a11y-scan: low contrast on chip-bg (#d0d0d0). recommend WCAG AA colors or 1px focus outline. ensure Enter/Space activation.

cristian: export plan: keep Download CSV in expanded ledger and account-level flatten export. PDFs should render ledger rows by default.

eli: perf: batch fetch aggregates for visible projects, cache with short TTL, avoid N+1. virtualize expanded table.

hannah: acceptance criteria: 1) compact mode reduces vertical height >=35% for orgs >5 projects; 2) invoice-download rate change <5%; 3) keyboard users can expand + export within 4 keystrokes.

cristian: I'll own export paths and PDF rendering. @nora please add dashboards.

nora: adding dashboards and session recordings for qualitative checks.

hannah: action items: design finalize colors + focus (hannah), eng lazy-fetch + virtualize (eli), product A/B plan (cristian), analytics dashboards (nora). Sync tomorrow 9:30am PT?

cristian: +1, booked.

hannah: will push updated mocks before the sync. :sparkles:
